CommunityApplications.Profile: Unraid apps by SirBusta, all open source (MIT). BudMinder is a self-hosted cannabis grow journal for home growers. Keep daily notes, measurements and photos for every plant, see live readings from AC Infinity, Vivosun, Ecowitt and Home Assistant sensors, and track your strains and seeds in the Seed Vault. It is based on Isley, an earlier open-source app by dwot. ESPN Fantasy Football Waivers emails you the waiver results of your ESPN fantasy football league a few minutes after each waiver run: who claimed which player, who they dropped and the FAAB bid. It is unofficial and not affiliated with ESPN. For help, use the Support link on each app's page to open its Unraid forum thread. You can also report bugs on each app's GitHub Issues page.
